title: Cargo Manifest — Gilded Tern, Bay Nine
author: Customs clerk E. Ardley (sealed)
notes: Bible 7.2: customs house copy. Clerk E. Ardley has been dead a year (11.3), so the seal predates a problem nobody checked; "S— token" is the unnamed buyer.

pages.text:
Consignor: Vane Deepworks.
Contents: GLENSTONE SAMPLES, dressed, 1 crate (heavy).
Customs seal: No. 114, clerk E. Ardley.
Consignee: to be collected at destination by bearer of the S— token.
